description:
Mount the two foundation HTTP endpoints on the testjig's axum router.

- POST /jmap: deserialize the request body as a JMAP request envelope, hand it to jmap_server::Dispatcher::dispatch, serialize the response envelope back as application/json. Honor RFC 8620 byte cap + JSON depth via the existing parse_request entrypoint (see warning in src/parse.rs).
- GET /.well-known/jmap: return a hardcoded Session JSON with all 8 capability URIs advertised (urn:ietf:params:jmap:{core,mail,chat,calendars,tasks,contacts,filenode,sharing,metadata}). Single hardcoded account-id under the single hardcoded principal.

The Session JSON is hand-written for the testjig and pinned in a const so it doesn't drift. A future slice may make it dynamic if needed.

## Acceptance

- POST /jmap with a Core/echo request returns the echoed payload
- GET /.well-known/jmap returns valid Session JSON with all 8 capability URIs
- HTTP errors (400 on malformed JSON, 413 on byte-cap overrun) surface cleanly
- cargo test --workspace clean (testjig may not have tests yet — that's slice .7)
- cargo clippy clean

## Depends on .1 (scaffold)
title: Axum router: POST /jmap dispatcher + GET /.well-known/jmap session endpoint
